To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of 1% wt water in oil emulsions with ionic liquid as demulsifier is a promising alternative to traditional demulsification processes.
ionic liquids are effective and efficient in the chemical demulsification of w/o emulsion with low water content, with a demulsification efficiency of up to 74% in 4 h.
ionic liquids can be successfully used as demulsifiers for the removal of very low water fractions from model w/o emulsion systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of an innovative and sustainable technology for water removal from produced water in the oil industry, which is based on the chemical demulsification of water-in-oil emulsions with ionic liquids.
the chemical demulsification of w/o emulsified systems by means of ionic liquids.
the chemical demulsification of a model water-in-oils (w/o) system by means of ionic liquids ( ILs ) at different temperatures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of 1% IL in water-in-oil emulsions containing only 1% water can lead to an increase in demulsification efficiency of about 10% in 4 hours, with respect to the same emulsion without demulsifier.
IL can be considered a good candidate for the demulsification of w/o model emulsions with low water content.
ionic liquids are promising candidates for the demulsification of low water content w/o emulsional mixtures.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ionic liquids are a promising class of compounds to be used as demulsifiers for the treatment of w/o emulsified water.
the use of [Omim][BF 4 ] as demulsifier for w/o emulsification containing 1% water is not effective, while the use of Aliquat ®336 and [Omim][ PF 6 ] is effective.
the use of ILs is a viable alternative to the use of conventional demulsifiers for the removal of water from low water content w/o emulsion.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ILs are effective demulsifiers for w/o emulsified water, even in the presence of low amounts of water.
the demulsification performance of the ILs depends on their chemical nature, which is reflected in the molecular weight and hydrophobic/hydrophilic character of their cations.
ILs are able to promote a significant demulsification of w/o emulsified systems containing 1% water.
